Block only confirmed semantic conflicts; unknown, stale, or unavailable evidence is recorded as advisory (Default)

Semantic evidence gate for AI PDX writes. Before writing .txt/.gui/.gfx/.asset/.entity content, effect/trigger/modifier names, scopes, and referenced ids are checked against CWT rules, the language server, and the workspace index. Incomplete evidence does not interrupt writes.
Ask the user at approval boundaries
Let the read-only reviewer approve low-risk requests first
Approval reviewer used by the AI agent. user=show approval cards, auto_review=ask the read-only reviewer before falling back to the user.
Read-only: no writes or command side effects
Workspace auto: allow normal workspace writes, ask for risky actions
Workspace auto review: workspace auto with an automatic read-only reviewer
Trusted automation: workspace writes without approval prompts
Full access: disable sandbox and approval boundaries
Persisted agent permission policy preset. The composer permission selector applies a workspace-session override without changing this default.
Ordered-token command policy rules. Decisions are allow, prompt, or forbidden; destructive built-in protections cannot be weakened. Broad allow prefixes for shells, interpreters, and Git are ignored.
Command token prefix to match, for example ["npm", "test"].
Decision applied when the token prefix matches.
Optional explanation shown in approval or rejection details.
